title: One work found under an arXiv id and an arXiv DOI was flagged as a metadata conflict

found.context: Stage B live run of verify_citations.py against the real indexes

observed_failure: Attention Is All You Need, cited by its arXiv DOI, came back with metadata_conflict: OpenAlex keyed it by DOI and arXiv by id, so the same work counted as two.
expected_behavior: Records reached through the source's own identifier are one work; only a title search can leave a choice for a person.

resolution.summary: work keys use the arXiv id when there is one; ID lookups never mark ambiguity

lessons: Live answers expose identifier aliasing that synthetic mocks never contain.
